'''Julian Fuss''' played a constructed list at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2). He qualified at the 2007 Netherlands regional (16 April 2007) for the final round of the [[2007 European Champions' MPC]] (17–18 November 2007)<ref name="sf-15832-216503">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=216503#p216503 [EUROPE]: Champions' MPC on 17th and 18th November], Tusken84 (Nico Kreidl), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (5 July 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125033315/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=15832 Internet Archive]</ref> and was listed 6th at the [[2008 Ralltiir Regionals]] in Hannover on 10 May 2008.<ref name="sf-19214-301014">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=301014#p301014 Ralltiir Regionals (Hannover/Germany)], Uber-Obi, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (11 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125174838/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19214.html Internet Archive]</ref>
